notes.title: Launcher update
notes.content:
Hello,

the old launcher was often misused and lead players to play in the minimum windowed resolution. With this update we restructured and beautified the launcher to be more intuitive:

[list]
[*] removing the save button
[*] saving is now done automatically on launching the game or editor
[*] higher launcher resolution & a nice background picture
[/list]

We also fixed errors in the mission texts, which was long necessary.

We hope, you enjoy the changes!

Stay healthy!

Kind regards,
Warptear Entertainment

notes.title: Nightork Adventures 1 will become free to play!
notes.content:
Hello Adventurers,

we decided to make Nightork Adventures 1 free-to-play in Orktober (Harr harr!) 2019.
Microtransactions are not planned - so you will have everything for free!
We hope that this will lead to more players and some more levels in the workshop.

Kind regards,
Warptear Entertainment

notes.title: New workshop level and bugfix!
notes.content:
Hello Adventurers!
We just released a new workshop level: "Dark Dreams", feel free to try it out!
And we also solved a bug caused by memory fragmentation.
This bug led to crashes when loading many levels successively without restarting the game.

Kind regards,
Warptear Entertainment

notes.title: Totems added!
notes.content:
Hi,

with the patch today, we have added totems to the game!
You can choose your totem in the pilot menu.
There are 3 of them:

Ice Bear: better survivability (same stats as before the patch)
Snow Tiger: better weapons
Frost Raven: better afterburner

You can check the detailed stats in the game!

Kind regards,
Warptear Entertainment

notes.title: Custom Control Bindings added!
notes.content:
You can now set custom control bindings in the settings menu.
They are stored for each pilot separately, so you can use different bindings for different pilots.
